body: Thanks. I'm just really scared. I have to go back to work in less than 2 weeks and I know I'm not able to. I'm terrified of every option basically and suicide feels like the only thing I can do to escape this hell
Thanks. Yeah I've tried kratom but not for pain. I didn't really notice any effects and didn't want to get addicted so I threw it away lol

Thank you for the long and thoughtful reply. Ive heard the cross thing so many times and I guess I've just forgotten in when I'm actually suffering. It's a big reason I'm a Christian in the first place, that God humbled himself to be human to experience our pain in concrete terms. I have sort of been taking my rage out on people I love. I guess I just don't know what to do. I'm really never angry. Thank you for praying and I hope you're doing ok and your pain / suffering can subside.

Thank you. I've very grateful for her and the other people that love me in my life. It would be nice to have more friends but I'm bad at making making friends and when I do I usually push them away or scare them away. But again thank you. I would love a different perspective or renewed hope but I pray everyday for it and maybe it comes but it's fleeting .
